message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card over to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **1,000 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches the discard pile’s **color**, **number**, or **symbol**. 3. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player calls you out, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score. | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **No Challenge** – ignore the “must have a playable card” rule for Wild Draw Four.
• **House Rules** – e.g., “Draw 3” instead of “Draw 2.” | **Quick Tips** - Keep an eye on the colors you’re running low on; try to play them early. - Use Wild cards strategically to change the color when you’re stuck. - Remember the “UNO” shout—losing it costs you two cards. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
